pathways: positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription, elongation

function.text: ELL encodes RNA polymerase II elongation factor ELL. Annotated molecular activities include phosphatase binding and cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription, elongation and snRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II.
